d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Select a category to indicate whether the customer account is standard or preferred.
Vælg en kategori for at angive, om kundekontoen er standard eller foretrukket.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Select a category to indicate whether the customer account is standard or preferred.

d8p1:LocalizedLabel.d8p1:Label: Drop-down list for selecting the category of the account.

d8p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d8p1:Label: Drop-down list for selecting the category of the account.

d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Select a classification code to indicate the potential value of the customer account based on the projected return on investment, cooperation level, sales cycle length or other criteria.
Vælg en klassifikationskode for at angive kundekontoens potentielle værdi baseret på forventet afkast, samarbejdsniveau, salgscyklussens længde eller andre kriterier.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Select a classification code to indicate the potential value of the customer account based on the projected return on investment, cooperation level, sales cycle length or other criteria.

Rulleliste til klassificering af et firma.

d8p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d8p1:Label: Drop-down list for classifying an account.

d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type an ID number or code for the account to quickly search and identify the account in system views.
Angiv et id-nummer eller en kode for firmaet for hurtigt at søge efter og identificere firmaet i systemvisninger.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type an ID number or code for the account to quickly search and identify the account in system views.

d8p1:LocalizedLabel.d8p1:Label: Drop-down list for selecting account ratings.

d8p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d8p1:Label: Drop-down list for selecting account ratings.

d8p1:LocalizedLabel.d8p1:Label: Type of address for address 1, such as billing, shipping, or primary address.
Adressetypen for adresse 1, f.eks. faktureringsadresse, forsendelsesadresse eller primær adresse.

d8p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d8p1:Label: Type of address for address 1, such as billing, shipping, or primary address.

d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the city for the primary address.
Angiv byen for den primære adresse.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the city for the primary address.

d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the country or region for the primary address.
Angiv landet eller området for den primære adresse.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the country or region for the primary address.

d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the county for the primary address.
Angiv regionen for den primære adresse.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the county for the primary address.

d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the fax number associated with the primary address.
Angiv det faxnummer, der er tilknyttet den primære adresse.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the fax number associated with the primary address.

d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Select the freight terms for the primary address to make sure shipping orders are processed correctly.
Vælg fragtbetingelser for den primære adresse for at sikre, at forsendelsesordrer behandles korrekt.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Select the freight terms for the primary address to make sure shipping orders are processed correctly.

d7p1:LocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the latitude value for the primary address for use in mapping and other applications.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the latitude value for the primary address for use in mapping and other applications.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the second line of the primary address.

d7p1:UserLocalizedLabel.d7p1:Label: Type the third line of the primary address.
